name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Multi-Channel Cloud and Moisture Imagery
description: Delivers calibrated imagery for all 16 ABI spectral channels simultaneously, combining visible reflectance factors (bands 1–6) and thermal infrared brightness temperatures (bands 7–16) in a single product. The multi-channel dataset supports RGB composite generation, fog detection, and cloud classification workflows.
